title: Guidelines for transportation of dead body and cremated remains of human beings by air
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard lays down guidelines for transportation of dead body and cremated remains of human beings by air.
clause_3_terminology: Guidelines for transportation of dead body and cremated remains of human beings by air

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
